mapper.select: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS count FROM notification_message WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0 AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY category
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_message SET biz_status = 'CLAIMED', is_confirmed = 1, confirmed_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE biz_type = 'PRODUCTION_CARD' AND biz_id = #{recordId} AND receiver_id != #{claimedByUserId} AND is_confirmed = 0 AND is_deleted = 0
